title: Core Web Vitals Explained Simply
intro: Google's three metrics for how fast and smooth your page feels to real users.

slides.heading: LCP
slides.subtitle: Largest Contentful Paint: loading.
points: Time until the main content appears
Fix: optimize images, use a CDN

slides.heading: INP
slides.subtitle: Interaction to Next Paint: responsiveness.
points: How fast the page responds to clicks and taps
Fix: break up long JavaScript tasks

slides.heading: CLS
slides.subtitle: Cumulative Layout Shift: stability.
points: How much the layout jumps while loading
Fix: set image sizes, reserve space for ads

slides.heading: Measure it
slides.subtitle: Free tools to check your site.
points: The web-vitals library for your own analytics

scenario.situation: A blog's mobile LCP is 4.8 seconds, well above the 2.5 second target.
scenario.problem: The hero image is a 3 MB PNG, so the main content takes a long time to appear.
scenario.fix: Convert it to WebP, size it for the screen and preload it. That alone can bring LCP under 2.5 seconds.
scenario.takeaway: Oversized images are a top cause of slow LCP.

cta: What's your site's LCP right now?
